name: mbrd
description: Dev-only tooling. The app has no runtime dependency and nothing TypeScript reaches the browser: tsc only checks, esbuild builds web/assets/app.js, and that bundle is what ships. `npm test` still needs no install - Node strips types natively from 22.18, which is why the floor above is not a bare 22. The three devDependencies are for the lint, the typecheck and the build.
